props.caption: Lean checks the encoded proof. Mathematicians still judge whether the encoding says the right thing.

items.note: Ukraine sank a Rosatom-controlled cargo ship in international waters; all 17 crew survived and the cargo remains unverified.
Attackers changed exposed water-controller settings across several states, forcing operators onto backups and manual procedures.
Unitree opened a 40.45 million-share offer that would place 10% of the humanoid maker into public hands.
OpenAI published Lean certificates for ten claimed advances, moving one part of the argument into machine-checkable form.
Reclamation set a wider operating envelope for Powell and Mead while leaving the first two-year rules unfinished.

items.what: Flood exposure fell to 178,837 people across seven districts, while breached embankments, 15,060 hectares of affected crops and 11,489 camp residents kept the recovery incomplete.
More than eight in ten surveyed Australian teenagers still used social media three months after the under-16 restrictions began, often without a platform requesting an age check.
India approved ₹84,084 crore for offshore seismic work, 60 deepwater wells and shared infrastructure intended to lower the cost of exploration through 2031.
Hamas accepted a mediator-written disarmament sequence in principle; Israel has not accepted the same order, strikes continued and no verified weapons transfer has begun.
Snap made wholly generated AI videos ineligible for Spotlight recommendations while retaining eligibility for AI-edited material carrying transparency labels.
